chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim, from Muhammad, from Ahmad, from Mufaḍḍal ibn Ṣaliḥ, from ʿAbd al-Raḥman ibn al-Ḥajjaj, from Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام, concerning:
Whoever fasts on the Day of al-Tarwiyah and the Day of ʿArafah—he عليه السلام said: it suffices him to fast one other day.

key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: the Day of al-Tarwiyah, the eighth day of Dhu al-Hijjah
key_terms.يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ: the Day of ʿArafah, the ninth day of Dhu al-Hijjah
key_terms.يُجْزِيهِ: it suffices him; it fulfills the requirement for him

ai.seo_question: If someone fasts on the Day of al-Tarwiyah and the Day of ʿArafah, is fasting one more day sufficient?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding fasting connected to the days of al-Tarwiyah and ʿArafah. It states that one who has fasted these two days is sufficiently credited by fasting one additional day afterward.
